# I Love Islam — llms.txt

> I Love Islam (iloveislam.life) helps visitors memorise the Quran by reciting
> aloud and getting word-by-word feedback. Free, no sign-up, no account.
> Quran text, translations and tafsir are sourced from Quran.com; audio is
> from named reciters. This tool checks which words were recited — it does
> not check tajweed, and a teacher is still needed for tajweed.
> See llms-full.txt for the full index, including every ayah URL.

## Hifz hub

- [Hifz hub](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz): Start memorising, continue where you left off, plans and streak.
- [Memorisation plans](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/plans): 7-day and 30-day plans per surah, plus the Juz Amma 90-day plan.
- [My progress](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/my-progress): Streak, daily goal, mistake log, export/import — stored on the user's device only.
- [Juz Amma](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/juz-amma): Juz Amma (Juz 30) — all 37 short surahs, shortest first, the beginner path.
- [Juz 30](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/juz/30): Juz 30 overview — same content as Juz Amma.
- [Ayat al-Kursi](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/ayat-al-kursi): Ayat al-Kursi (2:255) — single-ayah study page; Quran text via Quran.com.
- [Test Mode](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/test): Exam-style recall test — random ayahs from your memorised text, Arabic hidden, no cue; a reveal counts as a miss.
- [Voice Search](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/voice-search): Recite a few words of any ayah and find it instantly; every match opens in the coach.
- [Group Challenges](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/challenges): Memorise together — share a challenge code or link, track group progress. No accounts.
- [Read the Mushaf](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/mushaf/1): The whole Quran page by page, like the printed Madani mushaf — 604 pages, ornamental surah headers, ayah markers, juz markers, Uthmani script.
- [About](https://www.iloveislam.life/about): What the app is, who runs it, sources and privacy.
- [Contact](https://www.iloveislam.life/contact): Report a bug, suggest a feature, or ask a question.

## The whole Quran

All 114 surahs (6,236 ayahs) and all 30 juz are on the site — read, listen and memorise each one with the AI recitation coach. A few examples:

- [Surah Al-Fatihah (1), 7 ayahs](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/al-fatihah): Read, listen and memorise; Arabic, translation and tafsir via Quran.com.
- [Surah Al-Baqarah (2), 286 ayahs](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/al-baqarah): Read, listen and memorise; Arabic, translation and tafsir via Quran.com.
- [Surah Al-Mulk (67), 30 ayahs](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/al-mulk): Read, listen and memorise; Arabic, translation and tafsir via Quran.com.
- [Juz 1](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/juz/1): Alif Lam Mim — 148 ayahs.
- [Juz Amma (Juz 30)](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/juz-amma): All 37 short surahs, shortest first, the beginner path.

The full list of all 114 surah pages and all 6,236 ayah URLs is in llms-full.txt.

## Ayah pages

- Every ayah has its own page at /hifz/[surah-slug]/[surah]-[ayah] — for example /hifz/al-mulk/67-1 — with Arabic, translation, word-by-word, audio and tafsir via Quran.com. The full list (6,236 ayah URLs) is in llms-full.txt.

## Sources

- Quran text, translations (Saheeh International default) and tafsir (Ibn Kathir Abridged) via Quran.com.
- No claims are made here about tajweed accuracy: this site checks which words were recited, not tajweed.
